question: 2021年营业收入比2021年净利润多多少？

steps.description: Locate the 2022 operating revenue value in the financial table and read the number
Locate the 2022 operating revenue growth rate percentage in the financial table and read the value
Calculate 2021 operating revenue using the 2022 operating revenue and growth rate from previous steps
Locate the 2022 net profit value in the financial table and read the number
Locate the 2022 net profit growth rate percentage in the financial table and read the value
Calculate 2021 net profit using the 2022 net profit and growth rate from previous steps
Subtract 2021 net profit from 2021 operating revenue to find the difference
